server.embedMissing.title.note: Title of the page of an embed address without a map, in a frame on another site (server/app/pages.py).

server.embedMissing.text.text: Not found. This map does not exist, or it is no longer shared.
server.embedMissing.text.note: The only text of the page of an embed address without a map. It says the same for every reason, so that nobody learns whether a private map exists.

server.fallback.missing.text: The page of the map is not installed on this server yet (PAGE_FILE is missing).
server.fallback.missing.note: The map page of a server without the page file of the build. PAGE_FILE is the name of a setting: keep it.

server.fallback.data.note: The map page of a server without the page file: the words before the address of the data of the map, which follows as a link.

server.list.lead.note: The page of the public maps of a user or a team: the line between its name and the list of its maps.

server.list.empty.text: There are no public maps here yet.
server.list.empty.note: The page of the public maps of a user or a team, when there are none.
